name: Easyhome New Retail Group Corporation Limited
summary: Easyhome New Retail Group Corporation Limited, together with its subsidiaries, operates and manages chain stores in China. It operates in five segments: Leasing and Franchising Business; Decoration; Merchandise Sales; Financial; and Other. The company offers home furnishing store operation, leasing, management, and franchising services; home decoration services, such as personalized customization, mansion design, whole decoration packages, and partial renovation, etc.; financing, guarantee, and factoring services; AI design tools; digital solutions and precision marketing services, including live broadcasting, studio photography, and AIGC for home furnishing merchants; and other services.
